prerequisites: Appropriate knowledge of classical mechanics and ondulatory phenomena as treated in the course of General Physics 1

learning_outcomes.text: Know the basic phenomena of classical electromagnetism and the underlying physical laws.
Be able to resolve problems on the subjects treated in the theory lectures.
Be able to analyze electromagnetic phenomena and to interpret them on the basis of the mathematical formulation of the physical laws.
Be able to understand the physical phenomena of electromagnetism.
Be able to clearly present the basic concepts of electromagnetism and their consequences on observable phenomena.
Have acquired the learning skills related to electromagnetism, which are necessary to undertake successive studies with a high degree of autonomy.

teaching_methods: Problem-solving at the blackboard, possibly with student participation
Uploading slides and exercise texts on the Elly platform
assessment_rules: The examination is based on written tests, with exercises and theory questions, lasting two hours. Students can use a calculator. If the mark from the written test is at least 21/30, the examination is passed, and an oral test is not required but can be requested to improve the mark. If the mark is between 13 and 20/30, an oral test is compulsory to pass the examination. The oral test focuses on the knowledge and understanding of the topics discussed during the lectures. Online registration is compulsory for both oral and written tests.
bibliography: G. Cantatore, L. Vitale, W. E. Gettys, Gettys Fisica 2: Elettromagnetismo - Onde. McGraw-Hill Libri Italia, Milano.
